# Overview

#This notebook analyzes episodic memory across healthy controls and individuals with opioid use disorder, including participants with and without a history of non-fatal opioid overdose.

#Participant-level data are not included in this repository.

# Data Preparation

## Load packages

library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(effectsize)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggbeeswarm)

options(pillar.sigfig = 6)

# Load data
# Set this to the location of the dataset.
# data_path <- "/path/to/data.xlsx"

dat <- read.xlsx(
  data_path,
  sheet = "NA",
  na.strings = "NA"
)


# Define variables 

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Subject_ID = as.factor(Subject_ID),
    Grp = factor(
      Grp,
      levels = c("HC", "OUD-NOD", "OUD-OD", "OUD (other)")
    ),
    Grp_OUD_All = factor(
      Grp_OUD_All,
      levels = c("HC", "OUD")
    ),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    Race = factor(
      Race,
      levels = c("White", "Black", "Asian", "Other")
    ),
    Ethnicity = factor(
      Ethnicity,
      levels = c("Hispanic", "Non-Hispanic")
    ),
    Medication = factor(
      Medication,
      levels = c("Methadone", "Buprenorphine", "No medication")
    )
  )

# Define scanner

# The hippocampal volume dataset includes scans acquired on Siemens Trio and Prisma scanners. Scanner was included as a covariate in a sensitivity analysis.

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Scanner = case_when(
      Study %in% c("CURE", "XRNT") ~ "TRIO",
      TRUE ~ "PRISMA"
    ),
    Scanner = factor(Scanner)
  )
  
# Three-group ANCOVA

memory_dat <- dat %>%
  filter(
    Study == "Tau",
    Grp != "OUD (other)"
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

memory_model <- lm(
  ROC_AUC ~ Grp,
  data = memory_dat
)

car::Anova(
  memory_model,
  type = 3
)

# Effect size

effectsize::eta_squared(
  memory_model,
  partial = TRUE
)

# Estimated marginal means

memory_emmeans <- emmeans(
  memory_model,
  ~ Grp
)

memory_emmeans

# Planned contrasts

# The planned comparisons are:

# 1. Healthy controls vs. the combined OUD groups
# 2. OUD-NOD vs. OUD-OD

# Sidak correction is applied to the planned comparisons.

memory_contrasts <- contrast(
  memory_emmeans,
  method = list(
    "HC vs OUD" = c(1, -0.5, -0.5),
    "OUD-NOD vs OUD-OD" = c(0, 1, -1)
  ),
  adjust = "sidak"
)

memory_contrasts

confint(memory_contrasts)

# Effect sizes for planned contrasts

eff_size(
  memory_contrasts,
  sigma = sigma(memory_model),
  edf = df.residual(memory_model),
  method = "identity"
)

# Figure Generation

memory_plot <- ggplot(
  memory_dat,
  aes(x = Grp, y = ROC_AUC)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(color = Grp),
    width = 0.5,
    linewidth = 1,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar",
    aes(color = Grp),
    width = 0.5,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  theme_linedraw() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Memory performance (ROC AUC)",
    title = "Episodic Memory Performance"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = "none"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )

memory_plot

# Save the figure

ggsave(
  "Figures/Episodic_Memory.png",
  plot = memory_plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)


# Summary

# The analysis compares episodic memory performance across healthy controls, OUD without a history of non-fatal overdose, and OUD with a history of non-fatal overdose using a three-group linear model.

# Participant-level data are excluded from this repository.
